_metadata._comment: Background configuration for Runefall game backgrounds

_generation_metadata._comment: AI generation parameters used to create background assets

static_backgrounds.description: High-quality pixel art model for static level backgrounds

animated_backgrounds.description: Pixel art animation model for menu background frames

generation_parameters._comment: Backgrounds generated at 384x384 (model max), will be scaled to 600x900 in-game

workflow.step_1: Edit generation_prompts section below with desired background descriptions
workflow.step_3: Generated images are saved to paths specified in backgrounds section
workflow.step_4: For animated backgrounds, multiple frames are generated automatically
workflow._note: Requires REPLICATE_API_TOKEN environment variable to be set

backgrounds._comment: Background asset paths and display settings for each level and menu
backgrounds._note: Paths use Godot resource format (res://). Type can be 'static', 'animated', or 'shader'

level_1._theme: Fire and Earth elements - warm volcanic landscape

level_2._theme: Water and Air elements - cool flowing streams and sky

level_3._theme: All elements mixed - epic swirling elemental energies

menu._theme: Magical rune circle with mystical particles

_shader_example._comment: Example shader-based background configuration (not used by default)
_shader_example._usage: To use shader backgrounds, change a background's 'type' to 'shader' and add 'shader_path' and 'shader_params'

generation_prompts._comment: Text prompts used by background_generator.py to create AI-generated backgrounds
generation_prompts._note: These prompts are passed to Replicate models. Edit these to regenerate with different themes
generation_prompts.level_1: Volcanic cavern with glowing red and orange lava flows, warm fire and brown earth tones, mystical shamanic atmosphere, pixel art style, game background
generation_prompts.level_2: Serene sky temple with flowing blue water streams and white clouds, cool water and air colors, peaceful mystical atmosphere, pixel art style, game background
generation_prompts.level_3: Epic elemental nexus with all four elements swirling together, fire lava, water streams, earth rocks, air clouds mixing, intense magical energy, pixel art style, game background
generation_prompts.menu: Animated magical rune circle slowly rotating, mystical energy particles, pixel art style, game background, 8 frames
